scripts.docker:build:birdnetserver: cd birdNetServer && docker buildx build -t aopheim/birdnetserver --platform linux/arm64 --push . --progress plain
scripts.docker:build:picameraserver: cd CameraService && docker buildx build -t aopheim/picameraserver --platform linux/arm64 --push . --progress plain
scripts.docker:build:audiorecorderlinux: cd AudioService && docker buildx build -t aopheim/audiorecorderlinux --platform linux/arm64 --push .
scripts.docker:compose:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --force-recreate --build rpidaemon dev-db audiorecorderwindows
scripts.docker:compose:prod: sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --force-recreate --build rpidaemon audiorecorderlinux birdnetserver picameraserver
scripts.docker:compose:stop: sudo docker compose stop && sudo docker container stop budorbeach-audiorecorderlinux-1
